Frequently asked questions about crypto, Web3 & blockchain jobs▾
Where can I find crypto jobs and cryptocurrency careers?▾

SailOnchain lists 2,142+ active cryptocurrency, blockchain, and Web3 jobs from 1,256+ companies - engineering, product, marketing, trading, legal, and more. Filter by remote (975+ remote crypto jobs), skill, category, or experience level. Every listing links to the employer's own application page; browsing is free with no account required.

What kind of crypto and Web3 jobs are listed on SailOnchain?▾

SailOnchain aggregates 2,142+ active cryptocurrency, Web3, and blockchain jobs across engineering, marketing, product management, design, sales, trading, finance, legal, support, and operations. Listings come from 1,256+ vetted companies including major exchanges (Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, Bitpanda), custody providers (BitGo, Anchorage, Fireblocks), Layer 1 and Layer 2 protocols (Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base), DeFi protocols, NFT platforms, crypto-native VCs, and infrastructure providers.

How many of these are remote crypto jobs?▾

Approximately 975 of the 2,142+ listings on SailOnchain are remote crypto jobs open to candidates worldwide, with the remainder split across hybrid and on-site roles in major hubs (San Francisco, New York, London, Singapore, Berlin, Lisbon, Dubai, and more). You can filter by Remote, Hybrid, or On-site anywhere on the site.

What is the typical salary for a crypto or Web3 job?▾

Across all SailOnchain listings the median annual compensation sits around $170,000, with a typical full range of $151,500–$191,563 for senior engineering, product, and trading roles. Senior Solidity and smart contract engineers regularly clear $191,563+. Marketing, design, and operations roles tend to run 20–40% lower. See [hostname-redacted]/salaries for category- and region-specific breakdowns drawn from the same listings.

Do I need to know Solidity to get a crypto job?▾

No. Roughly half of the engineering jobs on SailOnchain require Solidity or smart-contract experience; the rest are backend (Rust, Go, TypeScript, Python), frontend (React, TypeScript), data, security, DevOps, or infrastructure roles that don't touch on-chain code directly. There are also hundreds of non-engineering roles in marketing, product, legal, finance, compliance, and trading where deep crypto-protocol knowledge is helpful but not required.

How often are crypto jobs added to SailOnchain?▾

New crypto jobs are added every day. Roles are pulled directly from each hiring company on a continuous schedule, deduplicated by title and company, and reviewed before publication. Typical lag from a job going live on a company's careers site to appearing on SailOnchain is under 24 hours.

Can I get entry-level crypto jobs without prior crypto experience?▾

Yes. SailOnchain has a dedicated entry-level crypto jobs section at /jobs/level/entry-level for roles tagged as Entry, Intern, or Junior. Many crypto-native companies (especially on the marketing, support, community, design, and ops side) hire candidates with strong general experience and only require crypto literacy, not deep on-chain expertise. Engineering roles are tougher to break into without crypto experience but possible if you've shipped open-source contributions to a major protocol.

Is SailOnchain free for job seekers?▾

Yes, SailOnchain is completely free for job seekers. You don't need to sign up to browse any of the 2,142+ crypto, Web3, and blockchain jobs, see salary data, or apply directly. Applications go to the hiring company's own application form (or email), so there's no SailOnchain middleman, no account required, and no upsell.

About SailOnchain - the crypto, Web3 & blockchain jobs board▾

SailOnchain is a dedicated crypto, Web3, and blockchain jobs board. We aggregate 2,142+ active cryptocurrency jobs from 1,256+ vetted Web3 companies across the industry, including centralized exchanges (such as Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, and Bitpanda), custody providers (such as BitGo, Anchorage, and Fireblocks), Layer 1 and Layer 2 protocols (such as Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base), plus DeFi protocols, NFT platforms, crypto-native funds, and many more employers beyond these examples.

Whether you're looking for web3 jobs, crypto jobs, blockchain developer jobs, smart contract engineering, DeFi product roles, crypto marketing, community management, compliance, trading, or any other crypto career path, SailOnchain's listings are updated daily, deduplicated, and filterable by remote, hybrid, or onsite. Roughly 975 of the listings are remote crypto jobs open to applicants worldwide.

Average compensation across the board sits around $170,000/year (median), with a typical full range of $151,500–$191,563 for senior engineering and product roles. See our crypto salaries breakdown for category, region, and seniority detail. Popular sections include blockchain & web3 developer jobs, crypto engineering jobs, crypto marketing jobs, Solidity jobs, DeFi jobs, remote crypto jobs, and entry-level crypto jobs.
